notes: both ... and is one correlative pair written for the single waw (rule 14). Neither locative be- is itself what both says — the rule's own lamed example is decisive — so both prepositions and both assimilated articles are unrepresented under rules 40 and 12.

on the day that I smote follows rule 52's b-yom case exactly: in to the preposition, the day to the construct, and the temporal that to the infinitive as nomen rectum, with the suffix taking the subject pronoun I (rules 18, 19).
are mine is rule 49's fused lamed plus suffix carrying the construction's copula.
